question: How is the beginningless tradition identified with cosmic restriction and scripture?
premises: Niyati abides as the impelling principle of the whole world.
That same principle is called scripture.
Scripture is identified with the traditional practice of the elders.
inference: The regulating power of the world, scripture, and ancestral convention are presented as one continuous authority.
plain_english: That very restriction abides as the impeller of the whole world; and that same thing is called scripture, namely the traditional course of conduct of the elders.
